QuestInfo.name: Edea's Urgent Summons
QuestInfo.0: Edea is summoning you. You have a bad feeling about this.
QuestInfo.1: Something serious has happened. Meet #bEdea#k in the #bDowntown Black Market#k.
QuestInfo.2: There's going to be a major battle tonight. You should go to the battlefield.

0.msg: Someone on the radio? I think it's Edea. I wonder what's going on...\r\n

1.msg: The headquarters is in danger. I don't know what's going on, but we need you here. Now.

yes.0: #b(What could possibly be going on? Meet Edea in the Downtown Black Market.)#k\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

0.msg: Edea needs to see you. Return to base.\r\n

1.0: I fear I've made a miscalculation. We've played right into the enemy's hands.\r\n

yes.0: The enemy set a trap for Kaiser, drawing him away from the base. With one of our most stalwart warriors out of the way, they're marching on us as we speak.\r\n
yes.1: I've ordered my troops to fall back. I want the enemy to think that we're on the run.\r\n
yes.2: Angelic Buster will hold the rear. Once the enemy has moved in, I want you to strike at their flank.\r\n
yes.3: This won't be an easy battle. Get into position and wait for the signal.\r\n

default.0: #b(What's going on? Things were going so well! You'd better get back to Edea in the Downtown Black Market.)#k\r\n
